info.title: Explaining Hearing Loss to Kids
info.subtitle: Simple, kind ways to help a grandchild understand

rows.title: Paint a picture
rows.desc: Compare it to a radio caught between stations.

rows.title: Keep words plain
rows.desc: "My ears miss some words, so please face me."

rows.title: Make aids ordinary
rows.desc: Explain they work like glasses, but for sound.

rows.title: Give them a job
rows.desc: Ask them to face you and speak one at a time.

rows.title: Book a hearing check
rows.desc: A quick evaluation keeps family visits close.
